text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at 6:30 and drink a glass of water before breakfast. After that, I get ready and start work at 9:00. I work until 5:00, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either by walking or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner and relax by reading or watching a series. I go to bed around 11:00. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel organised, healthy, and ready for each new day.
